semantics.rust_signature: fn triu_with_context_exact_native(backend: &CpuBackend, input: &Tensor, diagonal: isize, context: &ExecutionContext<'_>) -> Result<Tensor, ElementwiseRuntimeError>
semantics.shape_rule: rank must be at least two; the last two axes define rows and columns and leading axes batch independently
semantics.dtype_rule: preserves every canonical scalar dtype through exact byte copies and canonical zero encoding
semantics.numeric_rule: keeps element [row,column] exactly when column-row is at least diagonal and writes positive canonical zero otherwise
semantics.cancellation_points: before validation, at bounded element intervals, during upload, and before publication
semantics.vjp_rule: output gradient is masked by the identical triangular geometry
semantics.jvp_rule: input tangent is masked by the identical triangular geometry
